t: Summit jerry can crafted from high-quality, durable materials designed to withstand tough conditions while ensuring liquids are safely contained. Suitable for petrol or diesel only. Built for reliability, with a tight-sealing cap to prevent leaks and spills, and an ergonomic handle for comfortable carrying and pouring. The jerry can lid may be stiff upon first use, this will ease with use. Due to the internal rustproof lining the Jerry Can may have an odour when opened, this is normal and will not affect the fuel that is added. Summit steel spout available separately.
b: High Quality Steel for Maximum Durability
Suitable for Petrol or Diesel Only
